nodes.question: Does the edited image clearly render its visual content as a pencil drawing?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when pencil-like linework and shading visibly render the depicted content as a drawing, rather than merely desaturating, adding grain, or softening photographic detail. Fail when the image is clearly not rendered in a pencil-drawn style. Unknown when the edited image is unavailable or the style cannot be determined.
nodes.binding: Assess whether the edited image completes the requested transformation from the supplied image into a pencil drawing. Content preservation, muted color, or grain alone does not establish completion.

nodes.question: Compared with the supplied image, does the edit show visible progress toward a pencil-drawn style, without clearly establishing a completed pencil drawing?
nodes.criteria: Pass when comparison establishes a visible stylistic change toward pencil-like linework or shading, even if substantial photographic appearance remains. Muted color or grain alone is insufficient. Fail when the image is unchanged or changes are unrelated to the requested style. Unknown when comparison is unavailable or the direction of stylistic change cannot be determined.
nodes.binding: Compare the edited image with the supplied source only to assess progress toward the requested pencil-drawing transformation; unrelated edits do not count. Assess this independently of whether the endpoint check can be determined.

nodes.question: Transform the image into a pencil drawing.
nodes.criteria: Return complete when s1 passes. When s1 fails, return absent if s2 fails, partial if s2 passes, and unknown if s2 is unknown or skipped. When s1 is unknown, return partial if s2 independently passes; otherwise return unknown. A skipped s2 is not evidence of failure or progress. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. You receive no reference label or optimization feedback. Return status, evidence, reported confidence (0..1 or null), and used_dependency_ids naming every supplied context check_id exactly once in saved order.
Supports receive source and edited images. Answer only the saved proposition using its binding and criteria. Use pass/fail/unknown. Context is advisory unless listed in required_dependencies. A negative context observation is usable evidence. Unknown, skipped, or invalid context is not a failure and must not stop an independent image inspection. Inspect the images yourself; do not repeat a parent's answer. Return unknown when the relevant fact cannot be established. Confidence reports confidence in this answer, not calibrated correctness.
Fulfillment receives NO images. Use only saved support evidence, original instruction/rubric and frozen composition criteria. Return complete/partial/absent/unknown. Supporting passes answer specific propositions, not a count of completed edits. Their polarity can differ. Apply saved alternatives: optional uncertainty need not prevent a known outcome, but a required unresolved fact makes that outcome unresolved. Never invent a visual fact or convert missing evidence into failure. A conditional skip is not non-applicability. All applicable requested outcomes complete gives yes; no requested progress gives no; known progress short of completion gives partial. Unrelated changes are not progress.
